scope: Independent audit of Stage 25 source-status warning propagation. Read-only except added tests.
verdict: No path in grounded (production) mode returns legal text without its source-status warning. Two low-severity defects in legacy development mode only.

paths.note: Every returned chunk is a copy annotated with text_status; stored chunk untouched; same in exact and HNSW.
Status reaches the model prompt as context only; user warnings never depend on it.
Warnings built from cited_docs with citation numbers; status block appended to text; source_warnings field set.
Same path as answer. Previously untested at API level; Stage 26 test added.
Model-written question without warnings, but validated to contain no identifiers absent from question and evidence, and no evidence passage. Not legal text.

paths.path: no_support / unavailable / restricted / out_of_scope / missing_provision / server clarification
paths.note: Fixed backend messages only; no evidence text, no sources, empty source_warnings.
no_support with fixed message; Stage 26 test added.
Exception propagates to chat(), which returns HTTP 503 with PROVIDER_ERROR only; answer withheld. Stage 26 test added.
with_penalty_note appends after the status block; does not remove it.
Warnings for all retrieved chunks; see D1, D2.

Warnings are visible via the 'Source status:' block in the answer text (rendered by renderAssistantMarkdown) and a per-source status badge built with textContent. The structured source_warnings field is not rendered separately (no warning panel as proposed in Stage 24). Browser rendering not tested.

index_check.method: read-only sqlite on a scratchpad copy of chroma_telangana_preview_s11
index_check.finding: No other chunk of middle-main-chap-4.htm carries Rule 81 text under another provision_id.

defects.summary: Chunks with no sha256 metadata from different files collapse into one 'not recorded' warning that names only the first file.
defects.evidence: collect_warnings(invalid registry, [x.pdf, y.pdf] without sha256) -> one warning 'x.pdf: ...' citations [1, 2]
defects.impact: Every citation is still covered; label is incomplete. Unreachable in grounded mode (approved chunks must have a hash in SOURCES).

defects.summary: Registry edits are not reloaded until /approval/refresh or restart. ensure_approval_current marks a present approval stale but never reloads SOURCE_STATUS; with no approval file the fingerprint change is absorbed silently.
defects.impact: Development output may show warnings from the previously loaded registry. Grounded mode blocks (stale approval fails the gate).

already_covered_by_stage25: exact and HNSW (test_retrieval_annotation_keeps_chunk_identity_in_both_vector_modes, full suite in both modes)
